widgetTool.name: mortgage_calculator
widgetTool.description: Emit an affordability and payment calculator result after calculate_affordability tool call. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase: 'Let me show you your affordability breakdown.' Emit it whenever widgets_enabled=True, INCLUDING while you are speaking -- on a voice-enabled webchat the customer has both ears and a screen, so showing and speaking are complementary, not alternatives. Speak a short line and emit the widget. Only describe it aloud instead when widgets_enabled=False.

bounds.description: Slider min/max bounds. Optional; the widget has sensible defaults.

confirm_cta_label.description: Primary button label, e.g. 'Continue with these numbers'.

confirm_cta_value.description: Sent back to the agent on tap. The widget appends the current slider values, rate type, payment frequency and location as JSON.

first_time_buyer.description: Unlocks the land transfer tax rebate and a 30-year insured amortization.

interest_rate_pct.description: Illustrative rate only, and it must come from mortgage_rate_board rather than being invented. Labelled 'illustrative' in the UI.

payment_frequency.description: monthly | semi_monthly | bi_weekly | weekly | accelerated_bi_weekly | accelerated_weekly. Defaults to monthly.

property_city.description: Toronto triggers the additional municipal land transfer tax.

province.description: Two-letter code, e.g. ON. Drives land transfer tax and the sales tax on the insurance premium.

rate_type.description: fixed | variable. Fixed compounds semi-annually, variable monthly, which changes the payment slightly.

defaults.description: Starting values shown in the sliders. All CAD.

name.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'mortgage_calculator'

rate_options.description: Optional. Rate products from mortgage_rate_board, shown as a compact switcher above the sliders so the customer can feel the difference. Never invent an entry.

subtitle.description: Widget sub-header, plain and calm. Must not promise a pre-approval.

title.description: Widget header, e.g. 'Estimate your monthly payment'.

type.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'custom_template'
